narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the repository structure.
finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Of 380 commits, 13 things matter.

Four break callers. Internal error types no longer re-exported. The v1 export route is gone. Expired tokens return `401`, not `403`. The latency histogram unit changed, so old dashboards read wrong.

One feature: webhook retries with backoff. Eight fixes, the loudest being that request bodies stopped going to the logs.

Two things to check before you ship:

| Item | Why |
|---|---|
| `engines` in `package.json` | 11 commits touch Node 22, none prove a floor |
| Perf work | 10 commits, no heading for it in your shape |

Next: confirm the Node floor and say if you want a perf line.
